_doc: SSOT for per-model data (models) AND per-vendor metered-API data (vendors). Authored here (curated edits welcome); fast price tables derive in memory through model_catalog read APIs. See docs/CANONICAL_CONCERNS.json concern 'model_catalog'.

pricing_conversion.source: Existing sync.py documented provider conventions; Moonshot https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/batch.md

vendors._doc: Per-vendor metered-API rate limits — the SSOT the dispatch governor reads for its PROACTIVE cold-start cap (the floor applied BEFORE any response header, so a cold burst is paced from call #1 instead of storming). Response headers REFINE these upward to the account's real ceiling (dispatch.learn_rate_limit). Researched 2026-10-04 — anthropic AUTHORITATIVE (platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits, full tier tables); openai tier caps (developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/rate-limits), per-model rpm/tpm ride x-ratelimit headers (this account measured tpm=40000000 rpm=15000); gemini/zai/moonshot not publicly tabulated → conservative floor, refine from headers. units: rpm=requests/min, itpm=INPUT tok/min, otpm=OUTPUT tok/min, tpm=combined where one bucket. SAVED HERE so it is never re-researched.

_behaviors.acceleration_slow_start: Anthropic (and in practice others) 429 on a SHARP usage increase even BELOW the steady ceiling; documented remedy is to ramp gradually. => the governor must SLOW-START (ramp concurrency/rate from low), not fire full concurrency cold. This is the PRIMARY cause of a cold-burst storm.
_behaviors.cache_aware_itpm: Anthropic ITPM counts input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens but NOT cache_read_input_tokens (except Haiku 3.5). => pace input by fresh+cache_creation, and caching the repeated prompt lowers ITPM pressure.
_behaviors.otpm_realtime: OTPM meters ACTUAL output as produced; max_tokens does NOT count. => pace output by the learned expected output (expected_output.expect), never by max_tokens.
_behaviors.per_model_buckets: Limits are PER MODEL-FAMILY (opus separate from haiku). => key tpm/rpm by (vendor, family), via model_family_map below.
_behaviors.spend_cap_429: A monthly-spend-cap 429 carries error_code enforced_spend_limit_reached and NO retry-after — not a transient rate limit; do not retry it.

anthropic.note: New orgs may begin in an 'Evaluation' tier BELOW Start; Start is the safe published floor to assume cold, with SLOW-START on top handling Evaluation + acceleration limits.

openai.note: Per-model rpm/tpm are account/dashboard-specific and ride x-ratelimit-limit-{tokens,requests} on every response; this account measured tpm=40000000 rpm=15000 (~tier4-5). cold_floor is a conservative seed used only until a header is seen.

gemini.note: Public doc does not tabulate rpm/tpm/rpd (AI Studio dashboard); priority inference = 0.3x standard. Conservative floor; refine from headers.

zai.note: OpenAI-compatible; no public per-model table transcribed yet. Conservative floor; refine from headers.

moonshot.note: Kimi/Moonshot, OpenAI-compatible; no public per-model table transcribed yet. Conservative floor; refine from headers.
